note: Post holders confirmed by reading official council news items (GWF CORE public API, captured 2026-10-10 in council_sites/*_2026-10-10.json) that report a handover or swearing-in newer than the items a mention count would pick. holders.name: Nicodemus Tambo Mwikozi
holders.source_location: news[id=10513] dated 2026-10-03: RC MAKALLA AWAAPISHA WAKUU WA WILAYA YA ARUMERU, ARUSHA NA NGORONGORO
holders.source_title: Meru District Council news item 10513 (2026-10-03): RC Makalla swears in the District Commissioners of Arumeru, Arusha and Ngorongoro
holders.excerpt: Viongozi walioapishwa leo ni pamoja na Mkuu wa Wilaya ya Arusha Mhe. Nicodemus Tambo Mwikozi, Mkuu wa Wilaya ya Arumeru Mhe. Neema Kichiki Lugangira
holders.note: Sworn in on 3 October 2026; replaces Joseph Modest Mkude, whom council news named until 31 August 2026.

holders.name: Neema Kichiki Lugangira
holders.source_location: news[id=10822] dated 2026-10-09: DC LUGANGIRA AJA NA KAULI MBIU 3 (also news[id=10513], 2026-10-03, swearing-in)
holders.source_title: Meru District Council news item 10822 (2026-10-09): the Arumeru District Commissioner takes over the office
holders.excerpt: Leo tarehe 9 Oktoba 2026, Mhe. Neema Lugangira amekabidhiwa Ofisi ya Mkuu wa wilaya ya Arumeru tayari kwa kuwahudumia wananchi.
holders.note: Sworn in on 3 October 2026 and handed the office on 9 October 2026; replaces Mwinyi Ahmed Mwinyi, whom council news named until August 2026.

holders.name: Suleiman Msumi
holders.source_title: Meru District Council news item 10513 (2026-10-03): swearing-in of District Commissioners, caption naming the councils' directors
holders.excerpt: Mwl.Zianabu J.Makwinya Mkurugenzi Mtendaji wa Halmashauri ya WIlaya ya Meru na Suleiman Msumi Mkurugenz Mtendaji wa Halmashauri ya Wilaya ya Arusha
holders.note: Corroborates the leadership profile (Ndg. Seleman Msumi, updated 2026-03-12): still the District Executive Director on 3 October 2026. The caption spells the name 'Suleiman'.

holders.name: Rukia Zuber
holders.source_location: news[id=10407] dated 2026-10-02: Bomboko akabidhi ofisi kwa Rukia
holders.source_title: Hai District Council news item 10407 (2026-10-02): Bomboko hands over the office to Rukia
holders.excerpt: Hassan Omary Bomboko, amemkabidhi rasmi ofisi mkuu wa wilaya ya Hai Rukia Zuber, kufuatia uhamisho wake kwenda Wilaya ya Mwanga.
holders.note: Handover on 1 October 2026; Hassan Omary Bomboko moved to Mwanga District. Spelled 'Rukia Zuberi' in earlier Mwanga news.
